meta.title: Prompt Library — Manage and organise AI prompts
meta.description: Web application to manage, organise and search AI prompts. Open source on GitHub.

hero.title: Prompt Library
hero.subtitle: Manage, organise and search your AI prompts
hero.description: Open source web application to create, edit and organise prompts for different AI models, with categories, tags, full-text search and one-click copy.
hero.forkNote: Fork of YellowBerry007/prompt-database, with credit to its creator Berry @ Yellowgrape.

features.title: Features
features.subtitle: Everything you need to keep your prompt library under control

items.title: Create and edit
items.text: Create, edit and delete prompts with a complete form.

items.title: Hierarchical categories
items.text: Organise with two-level categories and tags.

items.title: Full-text search
items.text: Search across title, description and body of each prompt.

items.title: Combined filters
items.text: Filter by category, tag, platform, status and favourites.

items.title: One-click copy
items.text: Copy any prompt to the clipboard with a single click.

items.title: Usage tracking
items.text: Usage counter and last-used date for each prompt.

items.title: Favourites and duplicate
items.text: Mark as favourite and duplicate prompts easily.

items.title: Export and import
items.text: Export and import your library in JSON format.

items.title: Multi-user
items.text: User authentication and per-user prompt isolation.

items.title: Multilingual
items.text: Interface in Spanish and English, with language selector.
